options.metric: Number of pedestrians killed in reported motor vehicle crashes
options.denominator: None; annual count, not a rate
options.reason: Bars make the discrete annual totals easy to compare directly.
options.interpretation: This framing answers how many pedestrians were killed in each calendar year, with bar heights and labels showing the annual totals. Summing the per-crash pedestrian-killed field directly matches the requested count; it does not show fatality rates or pedestrian exposure.
